proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10055 māma gives Nepali/Hindi māmā and Prakrit māma mother’s brother. Kochila Tharu məmə fits with central vowels. The elicited seniority is contextual and is not reconstructed for the ancestor; the dictionary identifies a nursery formation. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: məmə.
